## Busy pods removed by event (R321)

busy_pods_removed replaces the defective retained v1 busy_removals. Each row copies the complete versioned classification, including target UIDs, deletion receipt, preceding snapshot, age, issues and interrupted claims. For container SIGKILL without pod deletion, missing-deletion-event means the deletion anchor is **NOT APPLICABLE**; the published ambiguous=true and null anchor remain unchanged. No deletion or busy-at-deletion value is invented. Other per-target issues, including non-worker targets in eviction drills, remain visible rather than being relabelled as worker removals.
